verdict.rationale: Confidence scores are well documented at page/block/word granularity (confidence_scores_granularity parameter), satisfying the calibrated-score half of the story. However there is no documented human-in-the-loop review workflow/UI/API for routing low-confidence fields to reviewers; the only mention of human review is anecdotal community practice ('you always have a low percentage that need human review'), not a product capability. Missing for 10: a documented review/routing mechanism for low-confidence fields, confirmation of confidence-score calibration/accuracy, and any UI or workflow for human review integration.
